title_en: Near the New Market, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!!
description_en: Near the New Market, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!! The apartment with an area of ​​76.18 m2 is located on the 5th floor of a well-managed new building.
